title: Record server time for leftAt; eject patches only leftAt
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Record server time for leftAt; eject patches only leftAt
Spec (61f2d14): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md L637: "a client update that sets `leftAt` to a non-null value signals the intent to leave, and the server stores its own current time instead of the supplied value". L2576: "Region owners and administrators MAY eject avatars by setting `leftAt` ...; the server records its own current time as `leftAt`. An eject update patches only `leftAt`."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:42-46; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:442; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/avatar.rs:476-505
Now: The client-supplied leftAt is applied verbatim through apply_patch_object and update_object. EJECT_PROPERTIES = ["leftAt", "worldState"] lets an eject also patch worldState (from the removed ejectReason example).
Change: When leftAt is set to non-null, replace the patch value with now_utc_string() and echo it in `updated` (RFC 8620 5.3: a server-changed value). Change EJECT_PROPERTIES to ["leftAt"] only.
Verifier correction: As proposed. Also update crate-jmap-scene-server/tests/avatar_set.rs:580-594, which asserts that an eject with worldState.ejectReason succeeds. That test's oracle is the removed Step 4 example, so changing it is an oracle update. Fix the backend.rs:413 and avatar.rs:44-46 docs as well.
